In the external vsim repo at /home/nick/work/vsim_andesim, I need to understand how a softcore's config file drives capability-gating of the hybrid CSR restore/drain. Find and report, with exact file:line and short code excerpts:

1. The config.inc / config source. How does a built vsim engine expose its config? Look for `obj_sc/config.inc`, a `--describe` command handler, and a function like `andes_caps_from_config()`. What does config.inc look like (a few example lines, e.g. NDS_NUM_PRIVILEGE_LEVELS, feature defines like POWERBRAKE/ECC/STACKSAFE/DSP/CLIC/SMRNMI/SMSTATEEN, VLEN)?

2. The AndesCaps structure and `andes_caps_from_config` (likely in src/hybrid/andes_caps.hpp or similar). How does it turn config defines into a set of supported CSRs? Show the gate logic (andes_gate_for, supports_csr). How does it decide, per CSR address, whether the engine implements it?

3. How `--describe` emits the "andes_csrs" list (the supported CSR names). Which function builds it (e.g. supported_andes_csr_names())? Show how it iterates the X-macro lists (HYBRID_ANDES_CSR_LIST / HYBRID_M_EXT_CSR_LIST) and filters by caps.

4. The restore gating: in src/hybrid/resume_driver.hpp, show the `if (caps_.supports_csr(addr))` checks around CSR writes. The re-read gating: in src/hybrid/state_drain.hpp, the same guard around CSR reads.

5. Where the AndesCaps is constructed at runtime - is it built from config.inc at engine startup, passed into ResumeDriver/StateDrain? Trace the construction path.

6. Is the QEMU plugin drain (producer) gated by these caps at all? Confirm whether the drain side is independent of vsim caps (I believe the plugin is in the andesim repo and drains whatever QEMU's gdbstub exposes, NOT gated by vsim config). Just confirm from the vsim side whether caps cross into the producer.

Be precise and quote the actual code with file:line. I'm writing a tutorial and need the real mechanism, not a vague summary. Report as a structured list; do not edit anything.

1	// Andes-CSR capability gating.
2	//
3	// A core implements an Andes custom CSR only when the matching feature is
4	// configured into it (config.inc). Restoring a CSR the target core lacks can
5	// hang the DMI handshake -- observed on ax45mpv_premium for ucode (no DSP) and
6	// mecc_code (no ECC). So the resume/drain loops transport only the CSRs the
7	// target core supports, decided here from the core's feature gates.
8	//
9	// This header is Verilator/SystemC-free: it maps a CSR address to its gate and
10	// answers "does a core with these gates support this CSR". The binding of each
11	// gate to the core's compiled-in `_NDS_*` config macros lives in the sim binary
12	// (see andes_caps_from_config), so this stays unit-testable in isolation.
13	#ifndef ANDES_HYBRID_ANDES_CAPS_HPP
14	#define ANDES_HYBRID_ANDES_CAPS_HPP
15	
16	#include <cstdint>
17	#include <string>
18	#include <vector>
19	
20	#include "hybrid/state_abi.h"
21	
22	namespace hybrid {
23	
24	// The hardware feature that gates each transported CSR. ALWAYS = unconditionally
25	// present (a base machine CSR every core has; never gated off). The first block
26	// gates the v3 Andes custom CSRs; the second block (UMODE..TRIGGER) gates the v4
27	// M-ext CSRs (HYBRID_M_EXT_CSR_LIST) -- standard + Andes M-mode CSRs whose
28	// existence depends on a privilege level or extension the core may not have.
29	enum class AndesGate : uint8_t {
30	  ALWAYS = 0,
31	  DSP,
32	  CODENSE,
33	  POWERBRAKE,
34	  STACKSAFE,
35	  ECC,
36	  PMA,
37	  ILM,
38	  DLM,
39	  PERF_MONITOR,
40	  // v4 M-ext gates.
41	  UMODE,       // needs U-mode  (NDS_NUM_PRIVILEGE_LEVELS >= 2)
42	  SMODE,       // needs S-mode  (NDS_NUM_PRIVILEGE_LEVELS == 3)
43	  EPMP,        // ePMP / Smepmp (mseccfg)
44	  SMRNMI,      // resumable NMI (mnscratch/mnepc/mncause/mnstatus/mnvec/mrnxvec)
45	  EXCSLVL,     // exception save levels (msave*)
46	  CLIC,        // CLIC / enhanced CLIC (mtvt/mintthresh/mcirq_entry)
47	  SMSTATEEN,   // state-enable (mstateen0..3)
48	  CCTL,        // cache control CSRs (mcctlbeginaddr/mcctldata)
49	  PPI,         // private peripheral interface base (mppib)
50	  FIO,         // fast IO base (mfiob)
51	  TRIGGER,     // debug triggers (tselect/tdata1/tdata2/tcontrol/mcontext)
52	};
53	
54	// Map an Andes CSR (by address) to the feature gate that enables it. Addresses
55	// are the HYBRID_ANDES_CSR_LIST scalars plus the PMA block. A CSR with no
56	// custom-extension gate is ALWAYS (a base machine CSR every Andes core has).
57	// Maintainer note: a CSR added to HYBRID_ANDES_CSR_LIST that needs gating must
58	// get a case here, else it defaults to ALWAYS (transported unconditionally).
59	constexpr AndesGate andes_gate_for(uint16_t csr_addr)
60	{
61	  switch (csr_addr) {
62	    case 0x801: return AndesGate::DSP;           // ucode (DSP overflow flag)
63	    case 0x800: return AndesGate::CODENSE;        // uitb  (CoDense table base)
64	    case 0x017: return AndesGate::CODENSE;        // jvt   (Zcmt/CoDense)
65	    case 0x7C5: return AndesGate::POWERBRAKE;     // mpft_ctl
66	    case 0x7C2: return AndesGate::ECC;            // mecc_code
67	    case 0x7C6:                                   // mhsp_ctl
68	    case 0x7C7:                                   // msp_bound
69	    case 0x7C8: return AndesGate::STACKSAFE;      // msp_base
70	    case 0x7C0: return AndesGate::ILM;            // milmb (ILM base)
71	    case 0x7C1: return AndesGate::DLM;            // mdlmb (DLM base)
72	    case 0x7D1: return AndesGate::PERF_MONITOR;   // mcountermask_m
73	    // v4 M-ext CSR gates (HYBRID_M_EXT_CSR_LIST).
74	    // mcounterwen (0x7CE) and mcountermask_u (0x7D3) need user mode (spec
75	    // existence: PMNDS & misa[20]); on an M-only core they WARL to 0, so gate
76	    // them UMODE -- not PERF_MONITOR -- or a restore writes a value the RTL
77	    // drops, false-diffing --verify.
78	    case 0x30A: case 0x306: case 0x7D3:           // menvcfg, mcounteren, mcountermask_u
79	    case 0x7CE:                                   // mcounterwen
80	    case 0x808: case 0x80B: case 0x811: case 0x813:  // uzobctl, ucctlbeginaddr, sleepvalue, umisc_ctl
81	      return AndesGate::UMODE;
82	    case 0x7D2: case 0x7D5: return AndesGate::SMODE;  // mcountermask_s, mslideleg
83	    case 0x747: return AndesGate::EPMP;           // mseccfg
84	    case 0x320: case 0xB03: case 0xB04: case 0xB05: case 0xB06:  // mcountinhibit, mhpmcounter3-6
85	    case 0x323: case 0x324: case 0x325: case 0x326:              // mhpmevent3-6
86	    case 0x7CF:                                                  // mcounterinten (PMNDS only)
87	      return AndesGate::PERF_MONITOR;
88	    case 0x740: case 0x741: case 0x742: case 0x744:  // mnscratch, mnepc, mncause, mnstatus
89	    case 0x7C3: case 0x7DE:                           // mnvec, mrnxvec
90	      return AndesGate::SMRNMI;
91	    case 0x7C9: return AndesGate::ALWAYS;         // mdcause (base Andes trap CSR)
92	    case 0x7D6: case 0x7D7: case 0x7D8: case 0x7D9:  // msavestatus, msaveepc1, msavecause1, msaveepc2
93	    case 0x7DA: case 0x7DB: case 0x7DC:              // msavecause2, msavedcause1, msavedcause2
94	      return AndesGate::EXCSLVL;
95	    case 0x307: case 0x347: case 0x7EC:           // mtvt, mintthresh, mcirq_entry
96	      return AndesGate::CLIC;
97	    case 0x30C: case 0x30D: case 0x30E: case 0x30F:  // mstateen0..3
98	      return AndesGate::SMSTATEEN;
99	    case 0x7CB: case 0x7CD: return AndesGate::CCTL;  // mcctlbeginaddr, mcctldata
100	    case 0x7F0: return AndesGate::PPI;            // mppib
101	    case 0x7F1: return AndesGate::FIO;            // mfiob
102	    case 0x7A0: case 0x7A1: case 0x7A2: case 0x7A5: case 0x7A8:  // tselect, tdata1, tdata2, tcontrol, mcontext
103	      return AndesGate::TRIGGER;
104	    default:
105	      // PMA cfg (0xBC0, 0xBC2) and addr (0xBD0..0xBDF) blocks.
106	      if (csr_addr == HYBRID_PMA_CFG0_CSR || csr_addr == HYBRID_PMA_CFG0_CSR + 2)
107	        return AndesGate::PMA;
108	      if (csr_addr >= HYBRID_PMA_ADDR0_CSR &&
109	          csr_addr < HYBRID_PMA_ADDR0_CSR + HYBRID_PMA_ADDR_NUM)
110	        return AndesGate::PMA;
111	      return AndesGate::ALWAYS;                    // mxstatus 0x7C4, mclk_ctl 0x7DF
112	  }
113	}
114	
115	// The set of Andes feature gates a target core has on. Built from the core's
116	// compiled-in config (config.inc) in the sim binary and injected into the
117	// resume/drain loops, so they transport only the CSRs the core implements.
118	// Default = every gate on (all(): no gating, the prior unconditional behavior).
119	struct AndesCaps {
120	  uint32_t gate_mask = ~0u;
121	
122	  static constexpr AndesCaps all()  { return AndesCaps{~0u}; }
123	  static constexpr AndesCaps none() { return AndesCaps{0u}; }
124	
125	  constexpr void set(AndesGate g, bool on = true)
126	  {
127	    const uint32_t bit = 1u << static_cast<unsigned>(g);
128	    if (on) gate_mask |= bit;
129	    else    gate_mask &= ~bit;
130	  }
131	
132	  constexpr bool gate_on(AndesGate g) const
133	  {
134	    return (gate_mask >> static_cast<unsigned>(g)) & 1u;
135	  }
136	
137	  // ALWAYS-gated CSRs are present on every core regardless of the mask.
138	  constexpr bool supports_csr(uint16_t csr_addr) const
139	  {
140	    const AndesGate g = andes_gate_for(csr_addr);
141	    return g == AndesGate::ALWAYS || gate_on(g);
142	  }
143	};
144	
145	// The gated CSR names this core supports, for the --describe card. Iterates the
146	// two single-source-of-truth X-macro lists: the v3 Andes custom CSRs and the v4
147	// M-ext CSRs. The driver uses this list to gate --verify, so a CSR the core
148	// lacks is neither restored, drained, nor compared.
149	inline std::vector<std::string> supported_andes_csr_names(const AndesCaps& caps)
150	{
151	  std::vector<std::string> out;
152	#define X(field, addr, name) if (caps.supports_csr(addr)) out.push_back(name);
153	  HYBRID_ANDES_CSR_LIST(X)
154	#undef X
155	  // PMA group markers (whole pmacfg[]/pmaaddr[] blocks share one gate), so a
156	  // consumer can include/exclude PMA without listing all 18 entries.
157	  if (caps.supports_csr(HYBRID_PMA_CFG0_CSR))  out.push_back("pmacfg");
158	  if (caps.supports_csr(HYBRID_PMA_ADDR0_CSR)) out.push_back("pmaaddr");
159	  // v4 M-ext CSRs share the same address->gate map and --describe list.
160	#define X(field, addr, name) if (caps.supports_csr(addr)) out.push_back(name);
161	  HYBRID_M_EXT_CSR_LIST(X)
162	#undef X
163	  return out;
164	}
165	
166	}  // namespace hybrid
167	
168	#endif  // ANDES_HYBRID_ANDES_CAPS_HPP

// Build an AndesCaps from the core's compiled-in config.inc feature macros
// (_NDS_*, supplied by the build-generated cpu_config.hpp). This is the ONE
// place that binds each Andes feature gate to its config macro -- the sim-binary
// counterpart of the Verilator-free andes_caps.hpp, kept separate so the unit
// tests never need the generated header.
//
// PRECONDITION: the _NDS_* macros must already be in scope (include this AFTER
// cpu_config.hpp). A macro that is absent reads as "feature off" (gate clear),
// never a compile error -- so a core whose config omits a knob stays safe.
#pragma once

#include "hybrid/andes_caps.hpp"

namespace hybrid {

inline AndesCaps andes_caps_from_config()
{
  AndesCaps c = AndesCaps::none();

#if defined(_NDS_DSP_SUPPORT_INT) && _NDS_DSP_SUPPORT_INT
  c.set(AndesGate::DSP);           // ucode
#endif
#if defined(_NDS_CODENSE_SUPPORT_INT) && _NDS_CODENSE_SUPPORT_INT
  c.set(AndesGate::CODENSE);       // uitb, jvt
#endif
#if defined(_NDS_POWERBRAKE_SUPPORT_INT) && _NDS_POWERBRAKE_SUPPORT_INT
  c.set(AndesGate::POWERBRAKE);    // mpft_ctl
#endif
#if defined(_NDS_STACKSAFE_SUPPORT_INT) && _NDS_STACKSAFE_SUPPORT_INT
  c.set(AndesGate::STACKSAFE);     // mhsp_ctl, msp_bound, msp_base
#endif
#if defined(_NDS_PERFORMANCE_MONITOR_INT) && _NDS_PERFORMANCE_MONITOR_INT
  c.set(AndesGate::PERF_MONITOR);  // mcountermask_m
#endif
#if defined(_NDS_PMA_ENTRIES) && (_NDS_PMA_ENTRIES > 0)
  c.set(AndesGate::PMA);           // pmacfg / pmaaddr
#endif
#if defined(_NDS_ILM_SIZE_KB) && (_NDS_ILM_SIZE_KB > 0)
  c.set(AndesGate::ILM);           // milmb
#endif
#if defined(_NDS_DLM_SIZE_KB) && (_NDS_DLM_SIZE_KB > 0)
  c.set(AndesGate::DLM);           // mdlmb
#endif
  // ECC: mecc_code exists if ANY RAM block is configured with ECC.
#if (defined(_NDS_DCACHE_ECC_TYPE_INT) && _NDS_DCACHE_ECC_TYPE_INT) || \
    (defined(_NDS_ICACHE_ECC_TYPE_INT) && _NDS_ICACHE_ECC_TYPE_INT) || \
    (defined(_NDS_ILM_ECC_TYPE_INT)    && _NDS_ILM_ECC_TYPE_INT)    || \
    (defined(_NDS_DLM_ECC_TYPE_INT)    && _NDS_DLM_ECC_TYPE_INT)
  c.set(AndesGate::ECC);           // mecc_code
#endif

  // v4 M-ext gates. Privilege-level gates from NDS_NUM_PRIVILEGE_LEVELS
  // (1 = M, 2 = M+U, 3 = M+S+U). An absent knob reads as off -- safe.
#if defined(_NDS_NUM_PRIVILEGE_LEVELS) && (_NDS_NUM_PRIVILEGE_LEVELS >= 2)
  c.set(AndesGate::UMODE);         // menvcfg, mcounteren, mcountermask_u, U-delta
#endif
#if defined(_NDS_NUM_PRIVILEGE_LEVELS) && (_NDS_NUM_PRIVILEGE_LEVELS >= 3)
  c.set(AndesGate::SMODE);         // mcountermask_s, mslideleg
#endif
#if defined(_NDS_NUM_TRIGGER) && (_NDS_NUM_TRIGGER > 0)
  c.set(AndesGate::TRIGGER);       // tselect, tdata1, tdata2, tcontrol, mcontext
#endif
#if (defined(_NDS_SMEPMP) && _NDS_SMEPMP) || (defined(_NDS_EPMP) && _NDS_EPMP)
  c.set(AndesGate::EPMP);          // mseccfg
#endif
#if (defined(_NDS_SMRNMI) && _NDS_SMRNMI) || (defined(_NDS_RNMI) && _NDS_RNMI)
  c.set(AndesGate::SMRNMI);        // mnscratch/mnepc/mncause/mnstatus/mnvec/mrnxvec
#endif
#if defined(_NDS_EXCSLVL) && (_NDS_EXCSLVL > 0)
  c.set(AndesGate::EXCSLVL);       // msave*
#endif
#if (defined(_NDS_ECLIC) && _NDS_ECLIC) || (defined(_NDS_CLIC) && _NDS_CLIC)
  c.set(AndesGate::CLIC);          // mtvt, mintthresh, mcirq_entry
#endif
#if defined(_NDS_SMSTATEEN) && _NDS_SMSTATEEN
  c.set(AndesGate::SMSTATEEN);     // mstateen0..3
#endif
#if (defined(_NDS_CCTLCSR) && _NDS_CCTLCSR) || (defined(_NDS_CCTL) && _NDS_CCTL)
  c.set(AndesGate::CCTL);          // mcctlbeginaddr, mcctldata
#endif
#if defined(_NDS_PPI_SIZE_KB) && (_NDS_PPI_SIZE_KB > 0)
  c.set(AndesGate::PPI);           // mppib
#endif
#if (defined(_NDS_FIO_SIZE_KB) && (_NDS_FIO_SIZE_KB > 0)) || \
    (defined(_NDS_FIO) && _NDS_FIO)
  c.set(AndesGate::FIO);           // mfiob
#endif

  return c;
}

}  // namespace hybrid
